summary: Recent updates to the compositing and layers area of Firefox have focused on improving performance and ensuring better handling of visual elements, particularly when it comes to scrolling and video playback. Notably, there has been significant work done to **streamline the handling of HDR (High Dynamic Range) video surfaces**, allowing for a richer viewing experience with enhanced colors and brightness. Additionally, improvements to the scrolling mechanism, such as batching scroll updates and syncing visual offsets, will lead to smoother interactions during web navigation. By optimizing how layers and textures are managed, these changes contribute to a more responsive and visually appealing browser experience _with no major changes_ expected for end users.
